verdict.rationale: Ollama's own docs show it runs open LLMs (e.g. Gemma 4) and lets users switch models. Community reports show a MoE model (qwen3.5:35b-a3b) running via 'ollama run', multimodal working as expected, and new registry or Hugging Face models available with one 'ollama pull'. missing for 10: evidence of embedding-model support, any evidence of the 'hundreds of architectures' breadth, and first-party documentation of MoE and multimodal architecture support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Switch models without changing your workflow.
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
A new model on HF or Ollama registry? One 'ollama pull' and it's available.
